repository.name: widget
repository.description: An event-driven serverless widget-processing platform on AWS.
repository.summary: A small, production-grade Go service that processes widget events through an EventBridge + SQS pipeline on scheduled EC2 compute.

release.name: Widget v1.0.0 — first production release
release.author: acme-bot
release.body: First production release of Widget. Adds an EventBridge-driven ingestion pipeline, an SQS durable buffer, a hardened EC2 worker, and CloudFormation infrastructure. Breaking: the legacy polling endpoint is removed.
release.summary: Widget v1.0.0 delivers the first production-ready event-driven pipeline.

architecture.overview: Widget is an event-driven pipeline: a webhook publishes to EventBridge, which buffers events in SQS; a scheduled EC2 worker drains the queue and processes each widget.
architecture.deploymentTopology: Single-region, single public subnet; serverless front door, scheduled EC2 compute.
architecture.scalability: SQS absorbs bursts; the worker processes within a scheduled window.
architecture.reliability: SQS provides durable buffering and retries; a dead-letter queue captures poison messages.
architecture.security: IMDSv2 enforced, least-privilege IAM, secrets in AWS Secrets Manager, HMAC-verified webhooks.

commits.subject: add SQS durable buffer with DLQ
fix race in the SQS drainer

cloudformation.summary: One stack defines the EventBridge bus, the SQS queue + DLQ, and the EC2 worker.

mermaid.summary: Webhook publishes to EventBridge, which buffers in SQS, drained by the EC2 worker.

changelog.summary: v1.0.0 adds the ingestion pipeline, SQS buffer, hardened worker, and removes the legacy polling endpoint.

implementation.summary: The ingestion Lambda validates and publishes events to EventBridge; a rule routes them to SQS; the scheduled EC2 worker drains and processes them, with a DLQ for failures.

contentIntelligence.summary: Widget v1.0.0 delivers a production-ready event-driven pipeline: EventBridge ingestion, an SQS buffer with a DLQ, and a hardened EC2 worker.
